material.description: scripts/apply-creeps-688g.py builds subs['armor'] and matches the key armor= in unit lines, but scenarios/moba/units.osd carries defense= (for example line 10, unit("creep", ...) defense=2), so a 6.88g armour value is silently dropped. The script's DROP set also removes ten placeholder heroes that must stay (docs/CONVERGENCE_688G.md section 9). Found during content-creep-neutral-ability-pass; the script was not run. Clearing action: write armour to the defense key, and retire or narrow DROP so the ten hero lines survive, then confirm units.osd still has them.
